title: Existence of normalized localized derived comparison data
statement: Fix the same schemes, morphism, coefficient rings, Global datum g and object V, and fix a LocalBaseData package b. Then the normalized derived portion exists: the zero-preservation instances, ordinary direct-image comparison and section identity, preservation of K-injectives, derived direct-image comparison with its representative equation and shift, derived pullback mate with its shift, and the counit mate equation.

source.place: Tags 08FI and 0FN5; the derived direct-image, pullback-mate and counit part of the local construction.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary direct-image isomorphism by restriction of scalars along coefficient_sections; its components are identity on sections. The inverse mate of this square is invertible by the ordinary localization theorem with its unit normalization.

Restriction to the slice preserves K-injective complexes by the existing containing-universe restriction theorem. Localize the exact pullback square termwise and take its mate under the actual canonical derived adjunctions. The generic localized_mate_cochain_normalization identity gives precisely the representative equation after cancelling the exact-model factorization isomorphisms. On K-injectives the two canonical right-derived comparison maps are invertible, so the derived mate is invertible there. Every derived object is isomorphic to such a representative; naturality transports invertibility to every object.

Exact-functor localization isomorphisms commute with shifts, and the canonical derived adjunctions commute with their fixed shifts. Mate compatibility therefore gives directImage_shift, while inversion gives pullback_shift. The adjunction mate counit equation is exactly mate_counit. Assemble the resulting data without changing any LocalDerivedData field or target.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08FI and 0FN5; normalized exact pullback localization and derived mate calculation, using the existing containing-universe ordinary comparison and K-injective restriction.

from.place: Derived comparison and mate fields of the Local construction.
